analysis_result.analysis: The model failed to correctly count the number of lines drawn in the video. Despite the ground truth clearly listing 7 distinct ropes (red, yellow, green, blue, white, orange, purple) with their coordinates and properties, the model hallucinated an incorrect total of 12 lines.
